changelog: Accuracy pass on permissions and troubleshooting. Corrects the scope description to the real full-mailbox OAuth grant (was 'scoped to the mailbox'), documents that gmail_fetch_emails defaults max_results to 1, adds the Gmail query-operator list, the spam/trash exclusion, and label-ids-vs-names. Rewrites the 403 row to lead with placeholder/example IDs (the most common real cause) instead of scopes, and adds a row for tokens invalidated by a Google password change.
summary: Read, search, draft, reply to, and organize Gmail from chat via the Gmail API. Use this skill when users want an inbox copilot — search and fetch messages, read by thread, list labels, create and send drafts, reply to threads, forward messages, manage labels, archive or trash messages, and retrieve attachment content.
